notes: Extracted 31 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/herosection.guide.tsx, which holds HeroSectionGuide itself) and docs/evidence/herosection.md (+ .brief.md) at 3f56271 (the #543 wording fix on docs-next); the guide was built for Documentation #160 at 93f5870 (Done, live 26 October as ccb4c4c). The guide file reads the same on origin/main and origin/docs-next; the evidence’s Web render line and the .brief.md icon line differ (docs-next replaced the shape word with “fully rounded” and “a rounded search field”), and neither is quoted. The guide’s Sources note (“0.1.78 (23 October build of Biscuit’s main)”) and the evidence (“mirror tag v0.1.78-c8526ae”) were checked on 26 October 2026 on c8526ae. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit’s main at dbe0e02, 27 October). Blobs compared: HeroSection.tsx is f594fba at c8526ae, d3efc90 at ace46ca and b2435fe at dbe0e02 and in node_modules (git hash-object), changed by Biscuit for Component Bug #404 (filed from #160, the only ticket #160’s comments record); InputSearch.tsx (2ad0691), IconButton.tsx (dd6c456), Title.tsx (065bcb1), TextInput and the design tokens are the same at c8526ae and dbe0e02 (the only utils change, web-focus-trap.ts, is not used here). The c8526ae→dbe0e02 diff: subtitle lost its default “Subtitle” and an omitted or empty one is hidden (125, 27–29, 182); showSearch={false} drops only the field and the row stays while there is a filter or filterSlot (203, 231); the filter and a filterSlot get { Secondary, Medium, Button / Size M } under their own modes, with Size M re-applied after the hero’s modes (15–21, 173–180, 217–218); the search row is inset 8 px at each side (41, 248); an empty-string or false slot counts as no slot (23–25). #404’s 27 October re-tests (ace46ca, then dbe0e02) confirm items 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 fixed and the inset added; its sizes (item 4) stay open. The guide sentences that no longer hold are left out and listed in the human flag (reviews/herosection.json), naming #404; the guide copy recorded today on the installed build already shows no “Subtitle” in any example. Every quoted sentence that is kept was read against the installed source: the root is a column with heroSection/background (white), padding 16 / 12 and gap 16, width 100%, so it fills its host; the title block is a Title with the hero’s modes over context7 Page Hero ({ ...TITLE_MODES, ...modes }), one line by default (Title.tsx numberOfLines 1), so a long title ends with an ellipsis; InputSearch gets value={searchValue} and renders value || '', so without searchValue and onSearchChange typing shows nothing, and it shows its clear button (“Clear search”) while the value is not empty; the field is flex 1 in the row and the filter an IconButton with ic_filter and filterAccessibilityLabel; children are cloned with the hero’s modes into a full-width View under the row; title defaults to “Page Title”, searchPlaceholder to “Search”, filterIcon to ic_filter and filterAccessibilityLabel to “Filter”. The Sizing heights (16, 50, 16, 42, 16, body, 16) and 360 × 140 still hold: the inset is horizontal, and #404’s dbe0e02 re-test measured 360 × 140. Strength: one quote holds an absolute word: /configuration/8 “The hero only passes the text on; the page does the filtering.” (everywhere, recommended: it describes every hero, and the evidence records “The section does not filter a list for you.”). Default-value facts (title, searchPlaceholder, filterAccessibilityLabel) and the dbe0e02 behaviour facts (showSearch, filterSlot, subtitle) back recommended items only. Nothing is required: no prop is required and no everywhere-absolute instructs. Left out, and why: the sentences in the human flag (showSearch removing the filter; filterSlot without Secondary and Medium and its caption and example modes; leaving subtitle out showing “Subtitle”; the second Do & Don’t pair on Button / Size S; the Left caption, the field width after the filter and gap, Figma’s “another 8 px” and the package’s flush row); the first Don’t caption is quoted only up to “Page Title” (its “and Subtitle” no longer holds). The Sources note in full: its version line; the Figma-against-package prop list (the facts carry the props and slots); its sizes sentence (the gap quotes Sizing instead) and its reported issues (stale, above). titleSlot and searchSlot, which only the Sources list names, style, testID, Color Mode, the hero’s other modes (Button / Size, Button / State, context 9, Context2, FormField States, InputState, Page type, Status: the evidence’s “change nothing visible” line and its Button / Size line were checked before Size M was pinned), the evidence’s Web render and Figma frame (360 × 466), the MDX’s “placeholder stays Search” advice, the playground’s controls and readout, and the guide’s “No transactions match” Text. useWhen/1 quotes the core principle (round 2’s reviewer noted that it restates it rather than a use condition, without flagging it). avoidWhen is the evidence’s record of Biscuit’s handwritten Storybook docs (“For a list page; not a marketing offer (PageHero) or search with no title (InputSearch alone).”, as the CardCTA and CardFeedback entries cite theirs); the MDX at dbe0e02 still says “A marketing offer with one button. Use PageHero.” and “Search with no page title. Use InputSearch on its own.” States: Empty, With a query and Focused from the States description, each in its own words; “The section itself has no states.” is kept in the Focused item. Evidence facts: children (“a full-width body under the row (cascaded modes)”) and context7 (Default adds the Title’s 12 / 8 padding, Card shrinks it to 14 px), both on code paths and components that are unchanged at dbe0e02. Gaps: one, Figma’s 44 px field, 42 px filter and 44 px title block against the package’s 42, 40 and 50, quoted from Sizing (checked 26 October on c8526ae; #404’s 27 October dbe0e02 re-test measured the same, and #404 stays In progress on it: Biscuit keeps the shared control sizes, Marcin to decide). Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every hero, host, group, row and value) and no other modes. Example 1 is the guide’s In context: a Screen stands for the guide’s ScreenFrame, and the hero’s body is a ListGroup of the guide’s five transactions (TX: titles, dates and amounts), each a horizontal ListItem with a MoneyValue in trailing and an empty onPress, as the guide renders them; MoneyValue has no entry and is kept as the ListGroup entry keeps it (ListItem’s own doc names MoneyValue for trailing). Example 2 is the filterIcon card (Watchlist, Stocks you follow, Search stocks, ic_sort, “Sort stocks”: the guide source’s values); example 3 is the Search only card. The empty searchValue and handlers stand for the page’s state; the guide’s HSView keeps the query in state and the In context page filters TX by it. The filterSlot card is not used as an example: on dbe0e02 the modes it sets on its Icon Button only repeat the slot’s defaults. Consistency with related entries: no guidance file names HeroSection. InputSearch’s entry agrees: a 42 px field, the clear button while there is text, value and onChangeText needed for typing and clearing, the screen filtering the list, a placeholder that names what people search (default “Search”), and the focus look; its “give it an accessibilityLabel with the same words as the prompt” cannot be followed through HeroSection, which has no prop for the field’s label, and its own web item says the placeholder names the field without one, as this guide’s “screen readers read both” does. IconButton’s entry agrees: Medium is 40 px (Figma 42), Emphasis steps the fill from solid (High) to tint (Medium) to none (Low) (gold in its own default AppearanceBrand; the hero’s filter is Secondary, so solid purple), and every Icon Button needs an accessibility label (the hero’s is filterAccessibilityLabel). ListGroup’s entry writes the same rows (horizontal ListItems with a MoneyValue trailing). ListItem and Text are undocumented entries (Text unused here); MoneyValue has no entry. Filter Bar: the guide, the evidence and the MDX at dbe0e02 never mention it. Nothing hand-written here uses the shape word Coin doesn’t have. Cross-check: round 1 raised 4 flags: /configuration/3 (showSearch), /configuration/6 (filterSlot) and /configuration/11 (subtitle) read the entry against the c8526ae guide and evidence, and /facts/gaps/0 said the evidence is dated 26 October and doesn’t call #404 still open; the gap was changed to the guide’s check (26 October, c8526ae) and to “(Component Bug #404)”. Round 2 (the entry’s final form) raised the same three and /configuration/5 (ic_sort and “Sort stocks” not in the rendered copy); all four are dismissed in reviews/herosection.json (the items follow the installed package’s facts, changed for #404; the values are the guide source’s own). Human flag (reviews/herosection.json): the c8526ae check and the sentences left out above, waiting for #404 to publish.
